head: a52f081

major.scenario: At S3 (80x24), scroll blocked down once so both j and k are offered. The width allocator removes i entirely. Press d and the persistent /autopilot explanation leaves room only for j/k; u, a and i are removed. register.tsx creates hotkey Buttons only for returned segments, so these are lost actions, not merely shortened labels. The operator cannot use the advertised pool/assignment keys or open help in that state without a pointer or changing the viewport. autopilotHint is not reset by switching tabs.
major.recommendation: Keep keyboard actions registered independently of fitting labels, and provide a compact or dismissible fallback explanation that preserves access to every overflowing group and help. Add interaction coverage at 80 columns after j and d, including production-empty assignments.

major.scenario: Use the full S3 fixture but make all three assignment states waiting/running. Compression reduces assignments.visible to zero before reducing pools/blocked. windowRows then renders only the more marker; a changes the offset but slice(top, top + 0) is always empty. No assignment can ever be viewed at that viewport. The production source is correctly empty today, but this breaks the explicitly supported injected Assignment contract and its future source connection.
major.recommendation: Give an overflowing navigable assignment group at least one actual row, or make its expand/scroll action reallocate a row. Verify every assignment is reachable after compression, including when none needs the operator.

major.scenario: S1-light and S1-dark, and all other theme pairs, are byte-identical. resolveTone only asserts that the theme string and role name are recognized, then returns the role unchanged; it never resolves a theme palette. A light-theme inactive/subtle contrast failure would pass every assertion and produce the same evidence. Thus the required two-theme readability check is not performed.
major.recommendation: Exercise actual theme resolution or a documented authoritative theme mapping and record the resolved foreground/background information for both themes. Keep the semantic roles alongside it. The external exporter is a reasonable sandbox workaround; the missing theme behavior is inside the harness, not a reason to add filesystem access to the mod.

minor.scenario: S6 shows model-7 through model-2 from an eight-model fixture, with no indication that this is a six-row subset. An operator looking for a smaller model can reasonably interpret the list as the complete daily breakdown.
minor.recommendation: Label the section as the six largest models, or put a compact omitted-model count on an existing row; preserve the six-model-row limit.

criteria.evidence: S1–S3 initially show pending count/oldest title, blocked entries and pool-0. S3 has four actual blocked rows, satisfying the overridden minimum. M2 identifies an unreachable assignment state under the supported input contract.

brief-view.ts prioritizes decision subjects/tasks, then assignment subjects, then unique blocked subjects; no repeated subjects in supplied overview shots. Distinct lanes sharing a task remain separate as required. Header/tab count badges are absent.

Supplied S1/S2/S3 have 21/18/14 content rows; S4 has eight. paneCap bounds emitted rows, and pad/spare rendering is removed. Actual dock resizing is explicitly unverified in the host probe; this is not represented as real terminal validation.
Supplied 80/120/160-column fixtures keep CJK columns and ellipses within the viewport. pool bars are consistent within each width. Interaction-driven control loss is assessed under criterion 5.

Two control rows are last in supplied shots, and d correctly uses the authorized /autopilot fallback. M1 shows that narrow-width fitting deletes live hotkeys after interaction; M2 shows zero-row assignment scrolling cannot reveal content.
Reviewed pane labels, states, missing/stale copy and controls use Traditional Chinese. Proper names, model names, units and command identifiers are retained. No Simplified Chinese UI copy found.
register.tsx defaults to overview and exposes exactly overview/pet, with no enclosing frames. Pet contains at most six model rows at the bottom.

Strict fleet.brief/1 schema/version and known-item field validation, 512 KiB/500 caps, known seven kinds, missing/bad/degraded states and five-minute age warning are implemented. Counts use the source; quota data uses the existing parser. S5 missing and stale are explicit. next_step_zh is only display-clipped; no generated pool advice is added. Production assignments remain empty.
Left labels, one vertical separator and warning/error emphasis establish useful hierarchy in S1–S5. S6 model truncation is unexplained (m1).
Semantic roles are present, but M3 means the mandated light/dark palette resolution is not tested. Identical theme files establish coverage of role names only, not theme readability.
Pool names/plans, same-width bars, right-aligned percentages and blocked columns line up in S1–S3. Model values align in S6.
No full decorative blank rows in provided shots. Pet sprite-only rows contain actual art, and the transparent outer sprite rows are cropped. No dock padding/spare is emitted.
Overview follows the specified Fable left gutter, vertical rule and compact single status row. Real side-by-side autopilot terminal presentation remains outside the submitted host evidence.

recommendation: Request changes and another independent round. No Critical demonstrated under the task overrides; usability Majors cap the score at 7. Fix narrow-width action reachability and zero-row assignment navigation, and replace the theme-name-only check with real theme resolution evidence. The exporter driver is acceptable given documented sandbox limitations. Preserve the explicit host limitations and require the separate PM 160x40 release approval after the gate passes.
